description: Straight north-south corridor in Ozette Wetlands variant A. Two portals (north end and south end) connected by an uninterrupted corridor along X≈0. A midpoint anchor (yt0xtl) sits at the center for objective dispatch. Same primitive as paru-A ga1.

portals.north: spawn_north at (0.05, -16.75) — gate on the north (low-Z) end
portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.02, 22.90) — gate on the south (high-Z) end

traversalNotes: Straight-line traversal: the autopilot can walk directly between spawn_north and spawn_south.
DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective routes through corridor_mid (yt0xtl). Walk current_gate → corridor_mid → objective → corridor_mid → next_gate.
Same shape primitive as paru-A ga1. Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
